title: Linked-worktree write exemption re-reads .git without the bounded no-follow read
outcome: The nested-worktree exemption in the read-only review scope decides "linked worktree" from the same bounded, no-follow, non-blocking read that delegation_git_boundary already performs on `.git`, so a FIFO or link substituted for `.git` cannot block a write or approval check, and both paths parse `gitdir:` the same way.
acceptance: Linked-worktree write exemption re-reads .git without the bounded no-follow read is done
